Only WASD, E, C. No escape/cancel key.

Let me reconsider the geometry. The notice board is at (2,7). I'm at (2,7). But maybe the notice board is a wall-mounted object and its "tile" is (2,7) but it's actually on the wall between (2,7) and (2,6) or similar. The map shows (2,7) as '@' (walkable). 

Key insight: The map shows (2,7) as walkable '@'. The world_observe says Notice Board at (2,7) blocks. These conflict. Perhaps the notice board is at (2,7) but I'm actually at a sub-tile position and the board is at the edge. 

Let me try pressing E while facing UP toward (2,6) — the board might be mounted on the north edge of my tile, read from (2,6) side... no.

Let me try a completely fresh approach: maybe I should try to interact with the notice board by pressing E while it's the nearest object. Since it's at 0 tiles, maybe E reads the nearest object regardless of facing in some cases. But it consistently targets front tile.

I've spent many attempts. Let me try the one thing I haven't: pressing E while facing DOWN and then immediately trying to move, in case reading the notice opens a panel that, when I press E again, closes and frees me.
